 - mixed512 rankdef/nearrank window [62,100) k=384: 22/77 gate-fallback -> +6.9ms LOSS (the exact-rank-3n/4 matrices do NOT cleanly resolve at k=384 in the mixed batch); psd/rowscale [25,48): 100% fallback at k=352/384 -> not low-rank-winnable. So ONLY dense+clustered are peeled.

Only 5 clustered + 2 dense of 60; cuSOLVER's n=1024 marginal is tiny (~1.4ms/mat, barely above its 28-mat knee) while the FP64 two-level path and the LR floor are expensive at n=1024. So the peel is correctly gated to n=512 only; mixed1024 stays whole-batch cuSOLVER.
